test_access: No test manifest open, no test-image open, no test inference; audited metadata only
fine_tuning: last stage only; BN statistics frozen; no train augmentation in baseline
checkpoint: macro-F1 then QWK; ties retain earliest checkpoint
selection_rule: mean validation macro F1; within .02 F1 and .02 QWK prefer smaller parameter count; no test selection
ablation_scope: selected baseline, two seeds on fold0, one factor at a time; confirm final recipe on folds1/2
segmentation_holdout: split within eligible official train images before patches; official test unused
compute_rule: profile before candidate fitting; AMP and bounded six-epoch screens; OOMs reported, no arbitrary Cartesian grid
inference: no clinical referral threshold; grade3/4-to0/1 is descriptive error bin only
